name: Marimoss · Gremlet #34
description:
A moss ball from the bottom of a quiet lake. Floats up whenever it's happy, which is always.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Marimoss in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
